description: What the shop sells (item ids and prices, with photos, dietary labels, allergens and what's sold out), where to collect, and which payments it takes. In chat apps that show cards, the menu appears as a card with the photos.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.
